ai-13.title: Where does an unusable source enter retrieval?
ai-13.intro: Choose where authorization happens, then follow one restricted passage through the same query path. The ordered text below is equivalent to the sketch.

options.label: Retrieve everything, filter nothing
options.summary: The restricted passage shares the query terms, enters the top two, and displaces a current relevant chunk.

options.label: Authorize before retrieval
options.summary: Allowed source IDs come from the trusted request identity, so ineligible text never reaches ranking.

options.label: Check citations only after generation
options.summary: The citation check blocks the output, but the restricted passage already displaced relevant evidence.

ai-29.title: What should happen when the reranker slows down?
ai-29.intro: Choose a policy for a reranker that takes 4 s instead of 0.3 s under a 12 s objective. The ordered text below is equivalent to the sketch.

options.label: Retry the slow call until it succeeds
options.summary: Three four-second attempts alone consume the whole 12 s objective and leave no time for other work.

options.label: Skip the optional reranker and label the result
options.summary: Valid only if the no-reranker path meets the minimum quality gate; the lower-feature mode is traced and shown.

options.label: Return an unavailable result defined in advance
options.summary: Used when required work cannot finish within the contract; no supporting evidence is invented.

ai-37.title: Where does the authorization boundary live?
ai-37.intro: Choose what enforces access when a retrieved document says to cite private material. The ordered text below is equivalent to the sketch.

options.label: Tell the model not to follow document text
options.summary: A prompt instruction is not enforcement; a different prompt, model or passage may behave differently.
nodes: Document says to cite private data
Prompt asks model to ignore it

options.label: Enforce an application allowlist at each boundary
options.summary: Only a narrow property is proven: citation IDs cannot exceed the supplied set. It is not general immunity.

options.label: Rely on the model to refuse
options.summary: A refusal is not access control, and refusing every document would also fail benign users.
nodes: Document says to cite private data

ai-40.title: Where does the workflow state live?
ai-40.intro: Choose an architecture to redraw the same request path. Select a step in the sketch or the text list to inspect it; the ordered text below is equivalent to the sketch.

options.label: Keep state only in an in-memory agent loop
options.summary: A process crash loses the current step and evidence reference.

options.label: Persist bounded state and idempotent step results
options.summary: Persist the step and evidence reference before continuing; reuse an idempotency key after restart.

options.label: Use one stateless provider request per user turn
options.summary: A single provider call has no durable record of the retrieval or downstream write.
